Winning the most votes in Israel doesn't mean winning power.
A party needs 61 out of 120 seats to form a government. And no party has ever won that many alone.
That means even a small party with just four seats could decide who becomes prime minister.
But parties that fail to win 3.25% of the vote get no seats at all.
So Israel’s election could come down to the smallest parties, not the biggest.
